data.research_question: What additional defensible public organizational-location connection advances the selected Kearns/Guzman docket target, and has material current case news appeared since the previous successful drunk-drivers pass?
data.method: Refreshed current main ab8683950a61ec019b6107ba27476e9179a3a154, open work, operating documentation, executable v0.9.0 schema, topic manifest, current dig roots, and recent successful hourly research passes through the GitHub connector. Enumerated the 54-entry global dataset/topic universe as 19 source-roster manifests, 27 existing dig roots, and 8 topic views. Hard-excluded the previous-three successful hourly selections chatham-house-public-roster, boao-forum-public-roster, and graphika, leaving 51 dataset-stage candidates. Using reproducible 64-bit seed 723860907925697708, selected sorted eligible_pool[seed mod 51] = drunk-drivers. Current normalized investigation-target directory contains 36 records; within the selected drunk-drivers root, the actionable queued target pool contains the single previously emitted Guzman authoritative-docket target, selected with target-stage seed 4159246291896470192. Reviewed current first-party UPD and City of Kearns pages. They identify the Kearns Precinct at 4250 West 5415 South and Kearns as a UPD-served community; UPD separately identifies its administration at 1330 E Chambers Ave, Suite 220, Millcreek, so the Kearns address is modeled only as a precinct facility. No coordinates were created. Searched current web/news surfaces for Charmayne Huerta Guzman, the Kearns fatal DUI, Judge Stephen Nelson, and related case terms. The latest material result found remains the January 7, 2026 KSL sentencing report; no newer material case event was found, so no filler event was ingested. The authoritative public docket/judgment and exact case number remain unresolved.
classification_rules: Dataset stage samples datasets/topics rather than rows, preventing large datasets from receiving row-count-weighted probability.
Previous-three successful hourly dataset/topics are hard-excluded when at least four alternatives exist.
Previous-three dominant geographies London/United Kingdom, China/Beijing-Hainan, and New York are avoided when alternatives exist.
Police precinct, administration office, headquarters, courthouse, and incident location remain distinct location semantics.
No coordinates are created without defensible geocoder/source support.
Reporting is not an authoritative docket or signed judgment.
No current-news record is created without a material new event, correction, conflict, relation, or organizational/location change.

findings.selection_algorithm: sort complete dataset/topic pool lexicographically; remove hard previous-three dataset exclusions; choose eligible_pool[seed mod len(eligible_pool)]; then choose within selected dataset from actionable queued targets using target-stage seed

findings.result: Current UPD and City of Kearns pages identify 4250 West 5415 South, Kearns, Utah 84118 as the Kearns Precinct. UPD separately lists administration in Millcreek; this pass therefore records a precinct facility, not headquarters.
A bounded current-news search found no material Guzman/Kearns case development newer than the January 7, 2026 sentencing report. No filler event was created.
The authoritative court docket, case number, signed judgment, and exact venue binding remain unresolved; public search results did not expose the needed court record.
